---
title: "Compare columns names for scientific data tables"
format: html
editor: visual
---

This script compares the column names of files in a single folder. It must be used when the curator wishes to check that all files in a single folder contain the same columns (variable names). It takes a folder as input and returns a CSV file in the specified folder as output.

```{r}

# Define the directory containing your .gpkg files
directory <- "2024/1114/Files"

# List all files in the directory (change the extension if needed)
files <- list.files(directory, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to extract column names
extract_column_names <- function(file_path) {
  data <- st_read(file_path, quiet = TRUE)
  colnames(data)
}

# Extract column names from each file
column_names_list <- lapply(files, extract_column_names)

# Find the union of all column names
all_columns <- unique(unlist(column_names_list))

# Create a data frame to report the presence/absence of each column in each file
report <- data.frame(file = basename(files))
for (col in all_columns) {
  report[[col]] <- sapply(column_names_list, function(cols) col %in% cols)
}

# Print the report
print(report)

# Save the report to a CSV file
write.csv(report, file = "2024/1114/Column_consistency_report.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
